phases.title: Foundation — layout, i18n, design system, deploy skeleton

tasks.title: Set up next-intl locale routing
tasks.desc: Install next-intl. Create app/[locale]/ layout with locale provider. Add messages/en.json and messages/fr.json with initial keys. Configure proxy.ts (Next.js 16; not middleware.ts) for locale detection and /en /fr prefixes. Export function proxy(request). Wire i18n/request.ts.
tasks.verify: bun run build && bun run lint

tasks.title: Design system — typography, colors, Tailwind config
tasks.desc: Define the premium fintech color palette (warm off-white, deep ink, metallic accent) and typography scale in Tailwind/CSS. Set up font imports (one sans for UI, one serif for long-form). Establish CSS custom properties for the theme.
tasks.verify: bun run build && bun run lint

tasks.title: Shared layout — nav, footer, locale switcher
tasks.desc: Build the site shell: top nav (Work | Writing | About | Contact | EN/FR), footer (GitHub, LinkedIn, Email, WhatsApp). Create locale-switcher component. All text from next-intl messages.
tasks.verify: bun run build && bun run lint

tasks.title: MDX content pipeline
tasks.desc: Set up MDX processing for content/work/ and content/writing/. Create utility functions to read frontmatter and render MDX. Create the case study template frontmatter structure. Add one placeholder MDX file to validate the pipeline.
tasks.verify: bun run build && bun run lint

tasks.title: Homepage shell
tasks.desc: Build the homepage: hero with positioning sentence (EN/FR), three flagship case study cards (placeholder content), 'how I work' section, latest writing teaser, contact CTA. Design the signature metallic case-study card component.
tasks.verify: bun run build && bun run lint
